items.title: Hubert Laws — Smithsonian Jazz Oral History

ctx.x: Don Sickler’s wife, Maureen. She works with him regularly. In fact they did a project, the live recording we did in Montreux. He was doing the editing and all that. She called me and told me about it. She was working with him on that project. Yeah, I’ve been around when he’s gone through some very vulnerable times. I call and try to console him. He was very appreciative of that. I guess maybe that’s why he let me touch his microphones.
It could be the humanitarian spirit. But he also could see that you commanded your instrument in a way that I’m sure he respected.
